description:
Key technologies: HTML/CSS/JS, Jquery, Axure, Proto.io, Balsamic, Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch
 Key skillset:  
 ability to take design files and deliver fully functional front-end prototypes  
 ability to integrate into PP frameworks and build front-end experiences  
 ability to work with back-end services and architecture to connect the front-end 
 pixel asset creation and ability to work closely with UX and visual designer 
 Top Three Skills: 
 1) Experience with HTML/CSS/JS, Jquery, 
 2) Experience Axure, Proto.io, Balsamic, Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch
 3) Experience creating protototypes from design assets
 Job Description: 
 PayPal’s design community is creating highly functional and beautiful experiences to transform payments and change the world. We are committed to design principles that emphasize creativity, craftsmanship, simplicity and delight.
 We are looking for a Design Technologist to build highly-nuanced, well crafted and functional prototypes as part of the design process and PayPal’s forward looking design language. The ideal candidate will have had experience working closely with designers, content writers, and product owners to iterate rapidly to deliver interactive prototypes on the leading platforms (Web, iOS, Android). 

 Primary Responsibilities 

 Ability to take design files and deliver fully functional front-end prototypes,  

 Ability to integrate into PP frameworks and build front-end experiences, 
 Ability to work with back-end services and architecture to connect the front-end
 Pixel asset creation and ability to work closely with UX and visual designers
 Day to day support and working relationship with the design team to build out flows and experiences
 Ability to take wireframes, visual mockups, and content specs in order to build out highly interactive prototypes
 Development of responsive web and native mobile apps for usability research and demos
 Support during usability testing for rapid iteration
 Communication and documentation of front-end requirements to back-end development teams
 Job Requirements 

 High proficiency in Swift and/or mobile native programming languages 

 Knowledge and understanding of programming design patterns
 Knowledge and understanding of frameworks used in developer environment
 Knowledge and understanding of mainstream 3rd-party frameworks
 Membership and active access to troubleshooting resources ie: Stackoverflow
 Proficiency in GIT
 High proficiency in image editing software, preferably the Adobe Suite collection as it encapsulates various tools used for design development
 Proficiency in use or knowledge of mainstream wireframing/mock-up software ie: Sketch, Balsamiq etc.
 Desired cognitive abilities 
 Ability to communicate effectively both to designers and engineers using concepts and terminology mainstream to those disciplines 

 When called for -- the ability to execute rapid prototyping techniques by offsetting quality of code for quantity for proof of concepts
 When timeline permits -- the ability to engineer and develop excellent code structure for long-term reusability
 The ability to competently apply a design style across an app UI even without the full set of design documentation
 The ability to correct flawed graphic assets sent from designers when time is not in abundance and/or communication with design team is not possible.
 Creatively solve programming or design problems as an individual or as part of a collective
 Rapid learning techniques when asked to learn a new paradigm
 Mental endurance when tight deadlines are required
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6+ Months 
 Candidate must have excellent verbal and written communication skills
